focus.title: 欧盟拟对中国电动汽车加征临时反补贴关税，最高达38.1%
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于6月12日公布初裁决定，拟对进口自中国的电动汽车加征17.4%至38.1%不等的临时反补贴关税，涉及比亚迪、吉利、上汽等主要车企。该措施预计7月4日起实施，中欧双方正就价格承诺等解决方案进行磋商。中国商务部表示将采取一切必要措施维护企业合法权益。出口企业应尽快评估关税影响，调整定价与供应链策略。
focus.title_en: EU Plans Provisional Anti-Subsidy Tariffs of Up to 38.1% on Chinese EVs
focus.summary_en: On June 12, the European Commission announced preliminary findings proposing additional tariffs of 17.4% to 38.1% on imported Chinese electric vehicles, targeting major producers including BYD, Geely, and SAIC. The measures are expected to take effect on July 4. China's Ministry of Commerce vowed to take all necessary measures to protect the legitimate rights of its enterprises. Exporters should promptly assess tariff impacts and adjust pricing and supply chain strategies.

case.title: 英国法院裁定：中国仲裁裁决因被申请人未获适当通知被拒绝执行
case.summary: 英国高等法院近期在Z公司诉W公司案中，以被申请人未收到仲裁庭关于仲裁员指定及开庭的适当通知为由，拒绝执行中国国际经济贸易仲裁委员会（CIETAC）作出的裁决。法院认为，仲裁程序存在严重瑕疵，违反自然公正原则。该案警示：跨境仲裁中务必确保送达程序合法有效，避免因程序缺陷导致裁决无法在境外执行。
case.source: 来源：英国高等法院判决 · 2026年5月
case.title_en: UK High Court Refuses Enforcement of CIETAC Award Due to Improper Notice
case.summary_en: In Z Co v. W Co, the UK High Court recently denied enforcement of a CIETAC arbitration award on the ground that the respondent did not receive proper notice of the appointment of arbitrators and the hearing. The court found serious procedural irregularities violating natural justice. This case underscores the importance of ensuring valid service in cross-border arbitration to avoid unenforceable awards abroad.
case.source_en: Source: UK High Court Judgment · May 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境争议调解示范规则正式发布，促进商事纠纷多元化解
policy.summary: 广东省司法厅联合香港律政司、澳门法务局于6月15日共同发布《粤港澳大湾区跨境争议调解示范规则》，旨在统一三地调解程序标准，便利跨境商事纠纷高效解决。规则涵盖调解员选任、调解程序、保密及和解协议效力等核心内容，鼓励企业优先采用调解方式化解纠纷。该规则自2026年7月1日起试行。
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Releases Model Rules for Cross-Border Mediation
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice, together with the Hong Kong Department of Justice and the Macao Legal Affairs Bureau, jointly issued the 'Model Rules for Cross-Border Mediation in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area' on June 15. The rules aim to unify mediation procedures across the three jurisdictions, facilitating efficient resolution of cross-border commercial disputes. They cover mediator selection, mediation process, confidentiality, and enforceability of settlement agreements, and will be piloted from July 1, 2026.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice · 2026.06.16

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：跨境数据流动监管趋严，企业应提前建设合规体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：随着欧盟《数据治理法》全面实施及中国《数据出境安全评估办法》修订，跨境数据流动面临更严格的双向监管。企业应建立数据分类分级制度，明确跨境传输场景，优先采用标准合同条款（SCCs）或认证机制。建议出海企业设置数据保护官（DPO），定期开展合规审计，并与专业律师合作制定应急预案，以应对突发的数据跨境执法行动。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Tightening Cross-Border Data Flow Regulations – Build Compliance Systems Early
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: With the full implementation of the EU Data Governance Act and the revision of China's Measures for Security Assessment of Data Cross-Border Transfer, cross-border data flows face stricter bidirectional regulation. Enterprises should establish data classification systems, identify transfer scenarios, and prioritize standard contractual clauses (SCCs) or certification mechanisms. It is recommended that overseas-bound companies appoint a Data Protection Officer (DPO), conduct regular compliance audits, and collaborate with specialized lawyers to develop contingency plans for sudden cross-border data enforcement actions.
